key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:135C
name: acknowledge_pending_interrupt_event
description: Reads a shared status byte and, when its low bit is set, calls through a stored routine pointer, then resets the byte to a fixed value. It works with the CIA interrupt control register and the custom interrupt request register to clear the pending event.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:13A8
name: decode_keyboard_serial_keycode
description: Reads a raw key byte from the keyboard serial data register, handshakes through the CIA control register, and stores the decoded key state in a table, using a keyboard layout string to map each code.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:14CC
name: split_value_at_ten_thousand
description: Divides the 32-bit value in D0 by ten thousand and packs the quotient and remainder into one word, passes it to a routine, then calls a second routine. The routines it calls receive the packed result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:14E4
name: convert_high_word_to_digits
description: Takes the upper 16-bit word of the value in D2 and extracts its four decimal digits by repeated division by ten, returning them packed as ASCII characters in one 32-bit result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1502
name: shift_table_pointers_by_plane
description: Flips a toggle byte, then writes four entries of low and high word pointers into a table, each pointer advanced by a fixed block size from the previous one. The toggle selects which of two base buffers starts the sequence.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:154A
name: wait_for_fire_button_press
description: Loops calling a routine and reads the CIA port A data register until one of the fire-button bits goes low. It then returns the masked button bits.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:156A
name: decrement_countdown_clock_fields
description: Increments one counter, calls two routines, then decrements a three-field countdown. A field that underflows is reloaded from a stored value and the next field is decremented, with the middle field wrapping at fifty-nine.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:15DE
name: clear_flag_then_wait
description: Clears the byte at the address held in the A5 register, then spins until another path sets that byte to a nonzero value. Only the clear and the wait loop appear in the code.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:15EA
name: poll_until_routine_returns_zero
description: Calls a routine repeatedly and returns once it reports a zero result. The loop does nothing else between calls.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:15F6
name: decrement_pending_count_and_fill
description: When a pending count is nonzero, decrements it and writes three runs of words through a routine call, of thirty-two, eight and sixteen entries. Each word is stored at a fixed offset from an output pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:165E
name: fill_nested_word_block
description: Runs an outer loop of sixteen passes that calls a setup routine, then an inner loop of sixteen words per row, each produced by a routine call and stored at a fixed offset of an output pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:16A8
name: fill_rows_of_word_entries
description: Runs sixteen outer passes that call a routine with the global block pointer, then write thirty-two words per pass through a routine call, each stored at a fixed offset of an output pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:16DC
name: step_packed_nibbles_toward_target
description: Compares the low and middle fields of two packed words and moves the second value one step toward the first in each. The top field is only compared and never modified.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1746
name: store_global_pointer_after_call
description: Calls a routine, then stores the address of the global block into two pointer fields, one addressed through the A6 register and one through the A5 register.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:175E
name: store_global_pointer_after_call
description: Calls a routine, then stores the address of the global block into two pointer fields, one addressed through the A6 register and one through the A5 register.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:177A
name: store_global_pointer_after_call
description: Calls a routine, then stores the address of the global block into two pointer fields, one addressed through the A6 register and one through the A5 register.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1792
name: initialize_table_of_address_words
description: Stores a series of fixed word constants into consecutive global table entries, several of them as pairs sharing an upper word, and zeroes the remaining slots.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:17F8
name: build_stepped_pointer_tables
description: Fills one table with four low and high word pointer pairs spaced by a large fixed step, then a second set of four pairs with a smaller step. It finishes by storing four fixed word pairs and returns the last pointer computed.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1844
name: set_fixed_pointer_pair_words
description: Writes four fixed low word and high word pairs into the global pointer slots and returns the input value in D0 unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1896
name: set_alternate_fixed_pointer_pairs
description: Writes four different fixed low word and high word pairs into the same global pointer slots and returns the input value in D0 unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:18A2
name: write_four_stepped_pointer_pairs
description: Writes four low and high word pointer pairs into a table, each pointer advanced by a fixed step from the previous one. It takes no input and returns nothing.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:18CA
name: copy_longs_into_duplicated_bands
description: Copies source longs into a destination area in three banded passes, storing each value at two or four offsets so the same data appears in several places. It calls a routine first and then zeroes a fixed block of longs.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1A88
name: copy_words_into_paired_offsets
description: Copies source longs in two bands of three groups, writing each value at the base offset and again ten longs later. It is the second copy pass of its caller.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1AFE
name: zero_global_long_block
description: Zeroes a large block of the global area, clearing two longs on each loop pass until the counter underflows.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1B14
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Does nothing but call one routine and return. It adds no data handling of its own.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1B20
name: save_fields_and_store_results
description: Saves two 16-bit fields into the previous-value slots, then stores results from two routine calls into global cells. One combined value has a fixed high bit set, and the low word of a pointer is written to a global.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1BB4
name: update_clamped_position_from_delta
description: Stores the new packed input in a record field and moves two 16-bit coordinates by the byte differences from the previous value. The first coordinate is clamped to a maximum of 319 and the second to a maximum of 199, and both stop at zero.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1C2E
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Does nothing but call one routine and return. It adds no data handling of its own.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1C42
name: update_percentage_and_status_flag
description: Calls a series of routines, computes a percentage of one field divided by another and stores it in a record field. It writes two result words into global cells and sets a flag byte when a comparison matches.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1D44
name: select_role_label_from_status
description: Chooses a fixed label such as ATHLETE, FLOATER, CLIMBER, WALKER, DIGGER, BUILDER, BLOCKER, BASHER, MINER or BOMBER from the bits of a status word and writes it into the output buffer. A record with no status gets a row of colons, and the athlete case returns zero.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1E60
name: format_three_digit_counter_text
description: Writes three decimal digit characters packed in a 32-bit value into a text buffer. Colon fillers are written first, and leading zero digits are dropped.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1EA8
name: format_two_digit_counter_text
description: Writes two decimal digit characters from a 16-bit value into a text buffer. Colon fillers are written first, and a leading zero digit is dropped.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1ED0
name: convert_word_to_packed_digits
description: Converts the 16-bit value in D0 into four decimal digit characters by repeated division by ten. The digits are returned packed into one 32-bit result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1EF0
name: render_two_digit_glyphs
description: For a nonzero value, splits it into tens and units and copies each digit's seven glyph rows from a table into the output at a fixed row spacing. For zero, it clears the masked bits of eight longs in the output instead.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:1F86
name: advance_record_counters_with_limits
description: Loops over thirty-two records, skipping inactive ones and returning early when a control byte is set. Each record's counter is advanced, reset at its limit with a flag bit possibly cleared, and an offset is recomputed from the counter and a stride.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2002
name: call_routine_for_active_records
description: Walks thirty-two records and calls a routine for each one whose first word is nonzero. It returns the value from the last routine call made.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2066
name: zero_global_word_block
description: Clears a large block of words in the global area, one word per loop pass, until the counter underflows.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2078
name: fill_entry_rectangles_by_index
description: For each of sixteen entries with a nonzero first word, computes a destination from its packed coordinates and an offset table. It fills a rectangle of bytes with a value built from the entry index and a colour word, using a fixed row stride.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2100
name: fill_record_rectangles_with_constant
description: Loops over thirty-two records and, for each nonzero one, fills a rectangle of bytes with the constant nine. The origin comes from packed coordinates and an offset table, with the same fixed row stride.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:215E
name: reload_timer_and_claim_slot
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, reloads it and claims the next slot from a four-entry pointer list. The slot's record is cleared, filled with its pointer, position and velocity fields, and the index advances.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:21F6
name: refresh_display_fields_on_change
description: When a level counter differs from its last value, it recomputes the display field and writes a digit character into a text buffer, then calls routines to redraw it. It also copies sixteen words from a stored pointer into the global block and updates a second display slot when its value changes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:22F6
name: load_palette_from_colour_chunk
description: When a flag is set, searches memory for the four-character colour map chunk identifier, then converts its three-byte colour entries into packed four-bit colour words. Seven of these words are written to the global palette block.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2330
name: copy_selected_frame_block
description: Copies 512 longs from one of four stored blocks into the global area, choosing the block from a table index minus one, modulo four.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:236A
name: set_pointer_to_indexed_block
description: Stores into a record field a pointer to a block in the global area, offset by a stored index times a fixed block size.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2386
name: initialize_record_fields_from_globals
description: Calls routines, then copies several global values into record fields, derives one field from a subtraction of halved offsets, and sets a long from a routine result. It also writes the low byte of that result into several flag bytes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2446
name: copy_record_fields_and_clear
description: Copies nine 16-bit fields from a source record into a destination record, then clears four counter words and a flag byte in the destination.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2494
name: walk_list_then_call_records
description: Calls setup routines, then either walks a minus-one terminated list calling a routine for each entry or makes a single call. It finishes by calling a routine for each nonzero record among thirty-two and returns the last result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2528
name: walk_terminated_list_then_setup
description: Calls two routines, then either walks a minus-one terminated list calling a routine for each entry or makes a single call. It finishes with four more routine calls.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2576
name: copy_record_rows_from_table
description: For each nonzero record among thirty-two, copies thirty-four bytes from a table entry indexed by the record's second field into an output row. The output pointer advances by one row size per record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:25B6
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Does nothing but call one routine and return. It adds no data handling of its own.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:261C
name: start_blit_after_busy_wait
description: Sets a pointer and several fields to fixed values, then writes the same blit size word four times, waiting for the busy flag to clear before each write. The offsets match the blitter size and status registers of the custom chip block.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2670
name: fill_scaled_index_table
description: Fills a table of 184 words with each index multiplied by a fixed scale, then zeroes forty-eight words at a fixed absolute address.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:269E
name: format_percentage_saved_status
description: Computes a percentage from two counters and writes it into a status line, with a plural suffix character chosen by whether a count is one. It then copies a 32-byte row from a table into the global buffer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2752
name: copy_long_run_until_wrap
description: Copies a large block of words from a pointer stored in a record into the global area, running until a 16-bit counter wraps around to minus one.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2768
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:27A2
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:27DC
name: collect_active_record_positions
description: Collects the positions of records whose flag is one, packing each as a pair of words. It then pads a four-entry list by repeating the collected entries, or by writing a fixed default pair when none were found.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:285A
name: find_first_marked_record_value
description: Searches thirty-two records for the first one whose marker field equals two, then copies its stored value into two words of the calling record and returns.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2886
name: scramble_and_checksum_code_bytes
description: Packs bits from several record fields into a sequence of bytes and adds a checksum nibble derived from their sum. It rotates the eight-byte result by an amount taken from one field, then calls two routines and clears a flag byte.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:29EE
name: wait_for_video_position_changes
description: Waits for the high byte of the video position counter to change, once for each count held in D0. It returns after that many changes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2A10
name: latch_fire_button_state
description: Updates a latch byte from the fire-button input bit: it clears the latch when that bit is low, and sets it to all ones when the latch was empty and the bit is high.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2BFE
name: blink_text_cursor_character
description: Reads a character from a table at a stored offset. Each time a countdown reaches zero it reloads the countdown and alternates a text slot between that character and an underscore.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2DF8
name: read_file_or_report_error
description: Calls DOS library routines to open and read a named file, and writes an error message with the file name through the output routines when the read fails. It returns the library result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2F3E
name: copy_counted_byte_run
description: Copies a counted run of bytes one at a time from the source pointer to the destination pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:2F4A
name: run_code_entry_with_checksum
description: Runs a nine-character text entry loop with dash fillers, handling delete, backspace and cursor keys. Once entry is complete it sums the entered bytes and, when the sum matches its stored check value, unpacks a packed value into the record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3048
name: configure_window_and_draw_calls
description: Sets a window width of eighty and a height of two hundred eight, stores a pointer to the global buffer and marks a flag byte, then calls sixteen routines.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:30C2
name: set_panel_marker_character
description: Writes the character one into a global text slot, clears a flag byte in the record, and calls two routines.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:30FE
name: advance_four_bit_frame_timers
description: Loops over seven eight-byte records. Where a delay field is zero, it advances a four-bit frame counter, reloading the delay to two hundred thirty when the counter wraps, and calls a routine; otherwise it decrements the delay.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3134
name: step_animation_records_with_delay
description: Advances a four-bit frame counter on one record, reloading its delay on wrap, then walks the following records and decrements each nonzero delay until the count held in a register runs out.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3196
name: run_code_entry_with_checksum
description: Runs a nine-character text entry loop with dash fillers, handling delete, backspace and cursor keys. Once entry is complete it sums the entered bytes and, when the sum matches its stored check value, unpacks a packed value into the record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:31C8
name: initialize_text_box_record
description: Sets two window size fields and a buffer pointer, and a limit of two hundred. It writes the character code forty into the buffer, clears a position field, and calls a routine to store its result.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:31FE
name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls one routine and returns its result pair unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3212
name: copy_column_strips_to_output
description: Copies a sixteen-word column from the global area into output rows spaced eighty words apart, repeating over four word columns for each of eighty row groups.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:328E
name: draw_text_glyphs_into_planes
description: Renders a terminator-ended list of text strings into a multi-plane output. Each character's sixteen-row glyph is looked up in the font table, and pixels are either overwritten or masked depending on a transparency flag.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3296
name: draw_text_glyphs_into_planes
description: Renders a terminator-ended list of text strings into a multi-plane output. Each character's sixteen-row glyph is looked up in the font table, and pixels are either overwritten or masked depending on a transparency flag.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:329E
name: update_bitmap_bits_from_records
description: Zeroes a table of nineteen fixed records, then for each active record clears one bit in a first bitmap and sets it in a second bitmap, with the bit position taken from the record's coordinates.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3322
name: build_pointer_list_from_widths
description: Builds a sixteen-entry pointer list from a width table, advancing each pointer by the entry's width or repeating the previous pointer for empty entries. It then calls a routine through a stored function pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:33EA
name: invoke_basic_fx_handler
description: Calls one routine and then calls through a stored function pointer, the same pointer used by the neighbouring effects routine. A text label in the executable names the module BasicFX.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:340E
name: invoke_full_fx_handler
description: Calls one routine and then calls through a stored function pointer, the same pointer used by the neighbouring effects routine. A text label in the executable names the module FullFX.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3432
name: toggle_flag_then_call_handler
description: When a flag byte is set, toggles one of two other flag bytes depending on whether a position is past a threshold. It then calls a routine through a stored function pointer.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3498
name: decode_backward_bitstream_runs
description: Decodes a compressed stream read backward from its end, using a bit buffer with a sentinel bit to choose between literal bytes and back-reference runs. It copies each run into the output and accumulates a checksum with exclusive-or.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:354E
name: consume_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a counted number of bits and refills it from the preceding stream word, setting a sentinel bit, when the buffer empties.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3568
name: unpack_iff_body_four_planes
description: Finds the BODY chunk identifier in memory, then unpacks its byte-run data into four planes of eighty bytes per row. A negative count repeats the next byte and a positive count copies literal bytes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:35A4
name: or_three_bitplanes_together
description: Combines three source bitplanes into one destination by bitwise OR, one long at a time, across a fixed number of longs.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3606
name: unpack_iff_body_five_planes
description: Finds the BODY chunk identifier in memory and unpacks its byte-run data into five planes of forty bytes per row, using the same run rules as its four-plane neighbour.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3644
name: unpack_iff_body_from_pointer
description: Unpacks byte-run data from the pointer in its input register into the plane buffer, without searching for the BODY chunk identifier first.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:36C0
name: poll_video_position_with_timeout
description: Polls a video position value for up to a fixed number of passes, setting a flag when it never passes a threshold. It then resets two counter fields and advances them when that flag is set.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:3706
name: run_frame_handler_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of routine calls and two stored function pointers to step one frame. Text labels endpic and endsample in the executable refer to picture and sample data.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:379E
name: unpack_leveldata_bitstream
description: Decodes a compressed stream read backward from its end into the output, copying literal and back-reference runs and accumulating a checksum with exclusive-or. The text label leveldata marks the packed data.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:37BA
name: step_records_against_terrain_bits
description: Advances each active record's horizontal position in steps and tests the terrain bitplane bits at the new position. When a step is blocked it reverses the step, and it branches to a special case when a record's state flag applies.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:38F8
name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:41BC
name: walk_records_with_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown on the current record and, when it expires, initialises the record's fields from a flag mask. It then walks the following records, moving each one that is not in a special state against the terrain bits.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4206
name: reset_record_motion_fields
description: Sets a flag word from the input value with a fixed bit pattern, sets two signed offset fields to fixed negative values, and clears two counter fields.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4AB6
name: mask_word_across_four_planes
description: ANDs one destination word with a mask and applies the same mask to three words at fixed plane offsets, clearing the bits outside the mask in all four bitplanes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4BD0
name: draw_three_by_three_block
description: Computes a destination from the record's packed coordinates and copies a three-row block of three bytes each from the record's stored pixel fields, using a fixed row stride. It then stores the input word in a record field.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4CD2
name: apply_terrain_tile_behaviour
description: Looks up a behaviour byte for the record's position in a tile map and stores it in the record. A nonzero byte is dispatched by its low nibble, which can reset the record's state, reverse its horizontal velocity by sign, or look up a secondary entry.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4E6E
name: initialize_scroll_bounds_and_sizes
description: Stores a global value in a scroll field, sets two offsets to minus two and two size fields to forty, clears two counters, sets a limit of three hundred thirty-six, then calls a routine.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:4EAC
name: tally_and_project_visible_records
description: Tallies active records into two counters by the sign of their vertical field. For records inside a horizontal window, it computes a screen offset from their coordinates and a table scale, and stores the result in the record list.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5668
name: mark_plane_three_then_scan
description: Clears the selected bit in three bitplanes and sets it in the third, then walks the record list, tallying records by sign and handling those inside the clipping range.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:566C
name: mark_plane_two_then_scan
description: Clears the selected bit in three bitplanes and sets it in the second, then walks the record list, tallying records by sign and handling those inside the clipping range.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:56C8
name: mark_plane_two_then_scan
description: Clears the selected bit in three bitplanes and sets it in the second, then walks the record list, tallying records by sign and handling those inside the clipping range.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5708
name: mark_plane_three_then_scan
description: Clears the selected bit in three bitplanes and sets it in the third, then walks the record list, tallying records by sign and handling those inside the clipping range.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5728
name: set_planes_one_and_three
description: Sets the selected bit in the first and third bitplanes and clears it in the second and fourth, then walks the record list, tallying records by sign and handling those inside the clipping range.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5888
name: setup_blit_for_record
description: For a record whose type is not one of three excluded types, clamps its coordinates, computes a destination address and a control word, and writes the blitter parameters into the custom chip block.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:59A2
name: blit_four_planes_with_wait
description: Computes a source offset and bit shift from a value, then starts a blit of four planes with the same size word. It waits for the blitter to finish before each plane.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5A5C
name: draw_string_glyph_rows
description: Draws a terminator-ended string into a bitplane buffer, looking up each character's glyph in a font table and copying its rows at a fixed row stride.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5B68
name: process_twenty_five_entries
description: Calls one routine for each of twenty-five consecutive table entries, advancing the source by one word and the destination by eight bytes per entry.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5B8C
name: pack_mask_bits_per_row
description: Advances a twenty-five-step counter, then builds one output byte for each of twenty rows by setting a bit for each of eight source bytes whose masked bits are nonzero. The bytes are written at an eighty-byte stride.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5BB2
name: pack_mask_bits_from_pointers
description: Packs the masked bits of eight source bytes into one output byte per row for twenty rows, with the source and destination pointers passed in registers instead of taken from the record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5C1A
name: clear_four_parallel_word_tables
description: Clears four parallel word tables in one loop, with three of them at fixed offsets from the second base, for four hundred eight entries.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5C40
name: pack_bitplane_longs_to_bytes
description: Converts a grid of longs into bytes by gathering every fourth bit of each long into one byte. The packed byte is written to four output arrays across fifty rows of forty columns.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5D54
name: run_blitter_size_passes
description: Sets blitter fields to fixed values, then writes the same size word four times, waiting for the busy flag to clear between passes.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5DBA
name: or_edge_mask_into_planes
description: Computes an offset from a record's position and ORs an edge mask into the word at that offset in two or more planes. The mask and the plane choice depend on the record's flag and a threshold comparison.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5DDA
name: or_low_mask_into_planes
description: ORs a low-byte edge mask into two bitplane words at a register offset. The first plane word is used only when the record flag is clear, otherwise a global word takes its place.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5DE6
name: or_high_mask_pair
description: ORs a high-byte mask into two bitplane words at a register offset.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5E00
name: or_low_mask_plane_pair
description: ORs the low-byte edge mask into two fixed bitplane words at a register offset.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5E1A
name: or_low_mask_mixed_planes
description: ORs the low-byte edge mask into a global block word and a second bitplane word at a register offset.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5E34
name: or_high_mask_plane_pair
description: ORs a high-byte mask into two fixed bitplane words at a register offset.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5E90
name: advance_scroll_and_blit_strip
description: Advances a scroll position by four units up to a limit, computes a source pointer and shift from it, then blits a strip of the global buffer and waits for the blitter.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:5FC0
name: advance_five_bit_counter
description: Increments a field and keeps it within a five-bit range, then calls two routines.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:6002
name: store_bitmap_dimensions
description: Stores the width and height inputs in globals, computes the row byte count as the width divided by eight, and stores the product of row bytes and height as the total size.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:6028
name: store_pair_of_globals
description: Stores the two 16-bit inputs into two global words.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:603A
name: setup_clipped_blit_path
description: Computes a row offset and width for an image, then chooses one of several blit paths from flag bits in a register. It sets the blitter modulo and mask fields in the record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:658A
name: count_tiles_in_clip_range
description: Counts how many sixteen-pixel columns a horizontal span covers within the clip bounds stored in the record and stores the count. A second span is handled when another flag bit is set.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A510
name: call_six_routines_passthrough
description: Calls six routines in sequence and returns its input register pair unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A514
name: store_channel_sample_pointers
description: Looks up a channel's table index from its number, stores half of two length fields from the source record, and stores a sample pointer offset by a fixed header size for that channel.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A534
name: start_audio_channels_from_mask
description: For each of four channel bits in the input, sets or clears the matching bit in a shadow byte. When a channel bit is set, it points that channel's sample address register at a stored pointer and sets its length to one word.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A538
name: call_four_routines
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A550
name: call_routines_when_flag_clear
description: Calls three routines, then four more only when a global word is zero.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A554
name: set_global_status_then_return
description: Calls one routine, sets a global status byte to one and then to fifteen, and returns the input register unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A5C0
name: spin_writing_colour_register
description: Repeatedly writes a fixed colour value to the colour zero register of the custom chip block, looping forever. It never returns.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A5C8
name: verify_words_sum_or_nop
description: Adds four stored words and compares the total with a fixed value. On a mismatch it overwrites a code word with a no-operation instruction, so the program changes its own code.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A5E8
name: program_cia_timer_sequence
description: For input values zero and one, points two buffer fields at the global area and writes the same five-byte sequence into the CIA timer and control registers. Other input values do nothing.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A668
name: clear_record_block_and_limits
description: Stores a pointer in a record field, clears a block of record bytes, and sets four 16-bit fields to sixty-three.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A6A4
name: call_three_routines_passthrough
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns its input register unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A6BA
name: store_channel_sample_pointers
description: Looks up a channel's table index from its number, stores half of two length fields from the source record, and stores a sample pointer offset by a fixed header size for that channel.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A718
name: search_for_four_byte_pattern
description: Scans memory forward from the current pointer up to an end pointer, looking for the four bytes in the input register, and returns at the first match or at the end.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A744
name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A74C
name: call_routine_per_string_byte
description: Calls one routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string, then returns the input register unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A75E
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without any other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A764
name: store_channel_header_bytes
description: Looks up a channel's table index, stores three bytes from the pointer into that channel's entries, then points four channel pointers at the position nine bytes before it.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A7B8
name: call_routine_per_string_byte
description: Calls one routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string, then returns the input register unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A7C8
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without any other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A7CE
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A7D8
name: call_four_routines_passthrough
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns the input register value unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A80E
name: reset_record_head_fields
description: Copies a word from a fixed slot into the first record word, sets one byte to all ones, and clears two more bytes in the record.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A824
name: copy_channel_bytes_when_valid
description: Calls four routines, then copies two stored bytes for a channel to two output locations, unless the channel's first byte is minus one.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A886
name: reset_fields_and_rotate_byte
description: When bit zero of the input byte is set, stores a pointer and clears a word and a byte in the record. It returns the input byte rotated right by one bit.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A89E
name: call_five_routines_passthrough
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns the input register pair unchanged.

key: holiday lemmings 1994 (1994)(dma design)[cr pdx]/Holiday Lemmings 1994 (1994)(DMA Design)[cr PDX].adf:HolidayLemmings1994/HolidayLemmings1994:2:A8D0
name: store_sample_bytes_in_record
description: When bit zero of the second input is set, copies two bytes of the first input into record fields, copies a third byte unless a flag is set, and clears a further field.
